name: facebakery_fill_vertex
describe: Per-vertex bake: pick the vertex position from the EnumFaceDirection table + position bounds, apply rotatePart, compute the directional shade color, interpolate the sprite UV (0.999/0.001 corner mix), and pack into the vertex int[7]. PURE: modelRotation=identity (rotateVertex no-op), post-uvlock uvs fed directly, sprite reduced to its 4 UV bounds, BlockPartRotation reduced to scalars.
